answer: The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, held in escrow until finality, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. By the spiral of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Every claim climbs the lantern of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the ivory re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
